Segmented "Went well" / "Grow next" card — both tab states shown.
Only the sample SENTENCES are boxed, so a parent can scan them: the parent's own praise gets a terracotta-spine box (why it worked sits underneath as a plain caption); each "try saying next time" script gets a peach-spine box with a copy affordance. Coaching prose and the benchmark stay unboxed.

Data is session 204e744a's latest run: the Chinese category names and single goal are coaching-narrative quirks, not the layout. [婴儿声] in the first quote is a raw transcription artifact.
